description: This Go source file generates plugin interface code, including hooks and API method wrappers, for the Mattermost platform. It parses plugin interface definitions, filters certain hooks, and produces generated Go code for RPC clients, servers, and timing layers.

methods.name: FieldListToFuncList
methods.description: Converts an AST field list to a string representing a function signature.

methods.name: FieldListToNames
methods.description: Extracts parameter names from an AST field list, optionally in variadic form.

methods.name: FieldListToEncodedErrors
methods.description: Generates code to encode error fields in a struct.

methods.name: FieldListDestruct
methods.description: Creates a destructured list of variable names from an AST field list.

methods.name: FieldListToRecordSuccess
methods.description: Determines if a record indicates success based on error fields.

methods.name: FieldListToStructList
methods.description: Converts an AST field list to a string representing struct fields.

methods.name: baseTypeName
methods.description: Extracts the base type name from an AST expression.

methods.name: goList
methods.description: Runs 'go list' command to get package directory paths.

methods.name: getPluginInfo
methods.description: Parses plugin directory to extract hooks and API interface definitions.

methods.name: generateHooksGlue
methods.description: Generates RPC client and server code for plugin hooks and APIs based on interface info.

methods.name: generatePluginTimerLayer
methods.description: Generates timing layer code for hooks and API methods.

methods.name: getPluginPackageDir
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin package directory path.

methods.name: removeExcluded
methods.description: Filters out excluded hook and API functions from interface info.
